items.briefing:
Cybercrime is becoming increasingly organised and automated, according to security firm Infoblox, meaning even small organisations like RTOs face more frequent and sophisticated attacks than ever before. On a positive note, Australian SMEs can now access a free cyber health check through MY CYBER GUARD, which is a straightforward way to identify vulnerabilities in your organisation without any cost.

Scammers also remain active across Australia, so staff should stay alert to unexpected emails, calls, or messages requesting personal or financial details. **Practical tip:** If your organisation hasn't had a cyber health check recently, consider registering for the free MY CYBER GUARD assessment at mycyberguard.com.au.

featured.title: MY CYBER GUARD launches free cyber health check for SMEs
featured.quote: Free cyber health checks help Australian SMEs identify and fix critical security vulnerabilities.
